requirements.quote:
If a sender uses a different controller than that specified in this
document, the chosen controller MUST conform to the congestion
control guidelines specified in Section 3.1 of [RFC8085].
requirements.condition: A sender uses a congestion controller other than the controller specified by this document.
requirements.required_behavior: The chosen controller conforms to the congestion-control guidelines in Section 3.1 of RFC 8085.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using an alternative controller that does not conform to those guidelines.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The selected controller can be identified and its behavior compared with the referenced congestion-control guidelines.

requirements.quote:
Similar to TCP, packets containing only ACK frames do not count
toward bytes in flight and are not congestion controlled.
requirements.condition: A packet contains only ACK frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Exclude the packet's bytes from bytes_in_flight accounting.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Increasing bytes_in_flight for the ACK-only packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet contents and bytes_in_flight before and after sending can be observed and compared.

requirements.quote:
Similar to TCP, packets containing only ACK frames do not count
toward bytes in flight and are not congestion controlled.
requirements.condition: A packet contains only ACK frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Exempt the packet from congestion control.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Applying congestion-control gating or accounting to the ACK-only packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send an ACK-only packet under congestion-limited conditions and inspect whether congestion control governs it.

requirements.quote:
Unlike
TCP, QUIC can detect the loss of these packets and MAY use that
information to adjust the congestion controller or the rate of ACK-
only packets being sent, but this document does not describe a
mechanism for doing so.
requirements.condition: Loss of packets containing only ACK frames is detected.
requirements.required_behavior: No adjustment is required; an implementation is permitted to use the loss information to adjust either the congestion controller or the ACK-only sending rate.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No behavior is forbidden by this optional statement.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The statement grants an optional choice and deliberately leaves its mechanism unspecified, so it supplies no mandatory pass/fail behavior.

requirements.quote:
The congestion controller is per path, so packets sent on other paths
do not alter the current path's congestion controller, as described
in Section 9.4 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: An endpoint maintains congestion-control state for one or more network paths.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain a congestion controller independently for each path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using one undifferentiated congestion controller as the state for multiple paths.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's state organization and behavior across multiple paths can demonstrate whether controllers are maintained per path.

requirements.quote:
The congestion controller is per path, so packets sent on other paths
do not alter the current path's congestion controller, as described
in Section 9.4 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: A packet is sent on a path other than the path whose congestion controller is being observed.
requirements.required_behavior: Leave the observed path's congestion-controller state unchanged as a consequence of that packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Altering the current path's congestion controller because a packet was sent on another path.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A multipath test can snapshot one path's controller state, send on another path, and verify isolation.

requirements.quote:
The algorithm in this document specifies and uses the controller's
congestion window in bytes.
requirements.condition: The specified congestion-control algorithm represents or uses the congestion window.
requirements.required_behavior: Express and operate on the congestion window in bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treating the congestion window as a packet count or another non-byte unit without converting it to bytes for this algorithm.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Congestion-window storage, arithmetic, and send-limit decisions can be inspected to verify that their unit is bytes.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST NOT send a packet if it would cause bytes_in_flight
(see Appendix B.2) to be larger than the congestion window, unless
the packet is sent on a PTO timer expiration (see Section 6.2) or
when entering recovery (see Section 7.3.2).
requirements.condition: Sending a packet would make bytes_in_flight exceed the congestion window, and the send is neither on PTO timer expiration nor while entering recovery.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending the packet under the stated non-exception condition.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the sender is required to withhold the packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can set bytes_in_flight and the congestion window, attempt a non-exempt send, and observe whether transmission is suppressed.
